scale-unlimited/declaration-strict-value.message: Use a var(--token) rather than a literal colour. The tokens are at the top of app/globals.css, each with its measured contrast ratio against the cream ground. A literal here is how a design system drifts - and it drifts fastest when a coding agent is writing the CSS.
Use a var(--token) rather than a literal colour. Declare the token in the :root block at the top of this file, with its measured contrast ratio, then use it here.
